title: Find every finite verb
subtitle: A paragraph becomes readable when its finite verbs are visible.
overview: Finite verbs form a paragraph’s clause skeleton: they carry person/number or a stated third-person form and make an assertion, question, command, or wish.
Mark them before translating. Participles and infinitives matter, but they normally depend on this finite-verb structure.

sections.title: What to mark first
rows: finite subjunctive in a purpose clause

items.en: Finite skeleton: he came, saw, and believed.
Finite verbs: he says; he is coming. ὅτι opens the content clause.
